Why a gifter, not a manager

We have watched thousands of hours of LIVE from the viewer's seat and know, concretely, what makes someone open their wallet at minute forty of a stream — and what makes them close the app. That is the knowledge we hand our creators.

A real manager

TikTok pays us directly from its own network incentive pool, based on how our roster performs overall. Our income depends entirely on helping you earn more. That is the only alignment that makes sense — and it is why we can afford to never touch your gifts.

What you get

  • Zero-cut earnings. $0 deducted from your gifts, ever. Your diamonds are yours.
  • Account protection. When a false strike or ban hits, a real person works your case through our agency support channel. We file, escalate, and keep you updated. (Outcomes are TikTok's call; the advocacy is ours.)
  • Computer streaming setup (Windows or Mac). Going live from a computer instead of your phone gets you sharper video, on-screen alerts, and graphics. We request a stream key on your behalf through our partner channel — that is the code that lets your computer broadcast to TikTok — then set you up end to end in OBS Studio (Open Broadcaster Software), the free streaming program most creators use, including overlays, alerts, and gift-triggered effects that measurably lift gifting.
  • PK battles and matchmaking. A PK battle (“PK” is short for player knockout) is a head-to-head LIVE match where you and another creator appear side by side and viewers send gifts to pick the winner. We organize matches against partners at your level — the fastest way to put your stream in front of an audience that has never seen you.
  • 1-on-1 growth coaching. Stream structure, hook timing, gift-goal design, schedule strategy, and a monthly walk through your numbers.

What we ask

We are selective, and we will tell you why. Under TikTok's network rules, a creator only counts toward the incentives that pay us — and fund what we give back — by showing up consistently. To stay active on our roster:

  • 7+ valid LIVE days per month (a valid day is 60+ continuous minutes)
  • 15+ total LIVE hours per month
  • 18 years or older, based in the United States
  • Not currently signed to another TikTok LIVE network

Already streaming near that? You will do well here. Just starting out? Tell us — we would rather build a ramp with you than set you up to miss a target.

What we won't do

  • We won't lock you in. Under TikTok's own rules every creator may leave their network at any time, for any reason. We will not make that awkward.
  • We won't promise unbans, reach, or feature placement. Those are TikTok's decisions. Anyone promising them is selling you something they do not control.
  • We won't ask you for money. No fees, no subscriptions, no "starter packages." If a network asks you to pay, walk away.

Questions

Do you really take nothing from my gifts?

Correct — zero. TikTok compensates networks separately, out of its own incentive pool, based on overall roster performance. We are never paid out of your diamonds.

Can I leave if it is not working out?

Yes, any time. That is your right under TikTok's rules, not a favor we grant.

Will you get my account unbanned?

We will file and escalate your case through our agency support channel and stay on it. We cannot promise an outcome, because that decision belongs to TikTok. Any network telling you otherwise is overselling.

Can you get me a stream key so I can go LIVE from my computer?

A stream key is the code that lets a computer broadcast to TikTok instead of streaming from your phone. We can request one on your behalf through our partner channel, and we will do the whole OBS Studio (Open Broadcaster Software) setup with you once it is granted. TikTok grants keys at its own discretion — but the request coming from a network carries further than one from an individual.

What if I stream in a language other than English?

Apply anyway and tell us. We are a U.S.-based roster, but we care about what you make, not what language you make it in.

Words you'll hear (and what they actually mean)

New to LIVE? Nobody explains this stuff, so here it is in plain English.

Diamonds

What the gifts your viewers send convert into. Diamonds are what you cash out — and 100% of yours stay yours.

PK battle

Short for player knockout. A head-to-head LIVE match: you and another creator side by side, viewers gifting to pick a winner.

Stream key

A code from TikTok that lets you broadcast from a computer instead of your phone. TikTok grants these case by case.

OBS Studio

Open Broadcaster Software — the free program most creators use to stream from a computer, with overlays and alerts.

Overlay

Graphics layered on your stream: gift alerts, goal bars, top-gifter lists. They make viewers want to gift.

Valid LIVE day

TikTok only counts a day toward network requirements if you streamed 60+ continuous minutes.

Ready?

Applications are reviewed by a person, and you will get a real reply — not a template. Never streamed from a computer, never done a PK battle? That is fine — that is precisely what we are here to teach you.
